dashboard.heading: Head Judge Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Select a round to control scoring flow
dashboard.noRoundsBody: Check back when the admin activates a competition and assigns you as head judge.

round.noPanelSelected: No judge panel selected for this competition. Choose one on the competition's edit page.
round.notReadyNote: The panel isn't fully staffed yet — starting will show an error until it is.
round.completedBody: Every attempt in this round has been judged.
round.partialNote: partial — not every judge has submitted yet, total will change
round.trickCountHelp: Lower this if the routine was interrupted before all tricks were performed. Judges pick up the new count on their next page load.
round.confirmSkip: Skip {{name}}'s attempt #{{number}}? This cannot be undone and no score will be recorded for it.
round.confirmComplete: Mark this round as completed? Any un-judged attempts will be left as-is.

flash.alreadyStarted: This round has already been started.
flash.notFullyStaffed: The judge panel is not fully staffed yet. Assign all required judges first.
flash.noAttempts: This round has no attempts to score yet.
flash.notStartedYet: This round has not been started yet.
flash.alreadyAtFirst: Already at the first attempt, there is nothing before it.
flash.movedBack: Moved back to the previous attempt.
flash.notInProgress: This round is not in progress.
flash.notAllSubmitted: Not every judge has submitted a score for the current attempt yet.
flash.completed: Round completed — every attempt has been scored.
flash.skippedAdvanced: Attempt skipped; advanced to the next attempt.
flash.skippedCompleted: Attempt skipped; round completed, no attempts remain.
flash.notCurrentAttempt: That attempt is not the round's current attempt.
flash.noPenaltyRole: You do not hold the head judge scoring role for this competition.
